name: feature.campaign-ops.nodes
description: Campaign operations node pack (ADR 0923). The change planner: `interpret` turns an operator's change request into structured intents or asks about missing facts (never both), and `propose` turns those intents into constrained before/after edits on the request's assets, minting a hashed change set. Both validate through ctx.features['campaign-ops'], make one error-fed repair, and otherwise fail with a typed reason. `execute` carries out an approved change set and verifies it by read-back. ADR 0957 adds the client-report steps: `compute-snapshot` freezes a report's figures from the app's own sources, `report-snapshot-read` reads a frozen report back, and `publish-report` publishes a reviewed report only if its numbers are the approved ones. Client memory adds client-notes-list and client-note-propose; only a person may approve a proposed fact into memory. Report publication uses a snapshot-bound approval from the same run under the client policy; P1 records publication internally.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Campaign ops: Interpret request
nodes.description: Reads one change request and either states what it asks for as structured intents or asks the questions needed to know (which Thursday, which link). Stores the validated result on the request. Inputs: { orgId, requestId, version, provider?, model? }. Output: { status }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: Propose change set
nodes.description: Reads every editable field of the request's assets and proposes the smallest edits that carry out the request's intents, leaving unrelated content untouched. Mints one change set per request version. Inputs: { orgId, requestId, version, provider?, model? }. Output: { changeSetId?, noChanges?, skipped? }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: Carry out approved change
nodes.description: Writes an approved change set to its destinations one at a time, each guarded by the version it was approved against, and confirms each one only by reading the destination back. Steps end confirmed, conflicted or incomplete; nothing reports done unless every step is confirmed. Inputs: { orgId, approvalId }. Output: { jobId, status, outcome }.

nodes.label: Client report: Compute snapshot
nodes.description: Runs a report definition's sections for its client and stores the figures, frozen and fingerprinted, as an internal draft report. Each figure is copied from the app's own source with its lineage; nothing is calculated here. A scheduled run passes the definition version it was armed with and fails if the definition changed since. Inputs: explicit { orgId, definitionId, definitionVersion?, periodStart?, periodEnd? }, or none for a host-bound client report run; host-pinned fields cannot be overridden. Output: { orgId, reportId, snapshotHash, snapshot }.

nodes.label: Client report: Read snapshot
nodes.description: Reads a stored report's frozen figures and their lineage, for the client the run belongs to. Inputs: { orgId, reportId }. Output: { found, reportId?, periodStart?, periodEnd?, snapshot?, snapshotHash? }.

nodes.label: Client report: Publish
nodes.description: Publishes a frozen report computed by this run only under its client policy or an explicit approval bound to the same snapshot and policy. Unknown, skipped, cancelled, unrelated or stale approvals refuse. Inputs: { orgId, reportId, snapshotHash }. No client delivery in this phase.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: Read client notes
nodes.description: Reads the curated notes in one client's shared agent memory (ADR 0944), bound to the run's client: a run for another client is refused. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { notes: [{ id, content, createdAt }] }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: Propose client note
nodes.description: Records an agent's proposed fact about a client for a person to approve. Nothing enters the client's memory until a person with write access on that client approves it. Bound to the run's client; idempotent per run node and text. Inputs: { orgId, content, rationale? }. Output: { proposalId, status }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: list campaigns (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P1 read tool. Lists one client's campaigns (id, name, status, channels). Binds the run to the client first. Inputs: { clientId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: get a campaign (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P1 read tool. One campaign's summary (aggregates only, no lead data). Inputs: { clientId, campaignId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: campaign performance (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P1 read tool. Spend, impressions, clicks and conversions per platform and currency. Inputs: { clientId, campaignId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: pending approvals (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P1 read tool. Open approvals on a client's campaign runs: title, roles, how many approvals; no payload content. Inputs: { clientId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: run status (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P1 read tool. A campaign run of that client: its status and what it waits on. Inputs: { clientId, runId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: explain a run's review decisions (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0942/0962 read tool. Which review-policy rule decided each step of a campaign run. Inputs: { clientId, runId }. Output: { text }.

nodes.label: Campaign ops: request a change (external agent)
nodes.description: ADR 0962 P2 request tool. Records an outside agent's change request for one client and starts the change-request workflow; the change waits for a person at the client to approve it. Inputs: { clientId, text, assetIds?, campaignId? }. Output: { text }.
